title: [BUG] OTEL_SDK_DISABLED to true but CrewAI still tries to push logs.
description:
### Description

I set the OTEL_SDK_DISABLED to true, as stated in the [documentation](https://docs.crewai.com/telemetry).
with:
`
import os
os.environ["OTEL_SDK_DISABLED "]="true"
`

I'm having:
`
ERROR:opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export:Exception while exporting Span batch.
